components.name: Spinner
components.description: Spinner — indeterminate loading. Track fill/soft-hover + arc accent/default (On color: fill/on-color-hover + static/white, for buttons and accent surfaces). S16 inline · M24 lists and buttons · L40 full screen. Rotate 360° · 800ms linear, loop.

components.name: Pull to refresh
components.description: Pull to refresh — appears above a scroll list. Pull: spinner at 40% opacity, arc grows with drag distance. Release: threshold reached (64). Refreshing: spinner rotates until data returns, then the list slides back. Haptic tick on Release.

5.7 Loading
Spinner (6 variants · Tone × Size), Skeleton (6 shapes) and Pull to refresh (3 states).
Overview
Show progress the moment a wait is longer than 300 ms. Skeleton when the layout is known, Spinner when it is not, Pull to refresh for user-started reloads.
